mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of each foreign shareholder or ultimate corporate parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry in the shareholder's jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Local notarization, then Hague Apostille by the apostille-competent authority of the source jurisdiction; for non-Hague states, consular legalization at the Republic of Korea Embassy or Consulate in the source jurisdiction. Apostille and consular legalization are parallel alternatives and must never be chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Existence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original resolution attested by the corporate secretary, notarized in the source jurisdiction, then affixed with a Hague Apostille; if the source jurisdiction is not a Hague member, complete consular legalization at a Republic of Korea diplomatic mission.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Constitutional Documents of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or authorized corporate records officer of the foreign shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the foreign shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank seal or branch letterhead, notarized, and apostilled by the Hague competent authority of the bank's jurisdiction; for non-Hague states, consular legalization by the Korean Embassy or Consulate covering that jurisdiction.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Every UBO, director, authorized signatory, and legal representative must be screened against the United Nations Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, EU consolidated sanctions list, Korean Ministry of Strategy and Finance sanctions designations, and KoFIU watchlists. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for politically exposed persons, their family members, and close associates. The screening must include biometric document verification, live-integrity passport checks, source-of-funds evidence, and ongoing transaction monitoring through an automated AML platform. Any positive hit, adverse media, or unexplained cross-border payment must be escalated internally and may trigger a suspicious transaction report to KoFIU before incorporation proceeds.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Supreme Court of Korea Internet Registration System (INTERNET REGISTRY) - Corporate Name Search and Registration Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered name of a Yuhan Hoesa must be in the Korean Han-geul script and must follow the statutory four-tier naming convention: proprietary element, business or industry descriptor, and the entity form suffix such as Yu-han-hoesa. A parallel English trade name may be registered for payment platforms and app store branding, but the Korean name remains controlling for legal process, registration notices, and tax invoices. Phonetic transliteration of foreign names is permitted only where explicitly stated in the registration application; irrelevant Chinese or Hanja characters are not recognized as the official corporate name for registry purposes.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 30 days of a name rejection, the foreign shareholder through its Korean legal representative must file a written objection with the competent district court registration office under the Supreme Court Registration Procedures Rules. The objection must state the business necessity, provide a fresh official name search showing no identical or substantially indistinguishable registered company or trademark, and attach the proposed Korean and English name in the four-tier format. If the court upholds the rejection, an administrative appeal may be filed under the Administrative Litigation Act. In urgent commercial cases a new name application may be submitted immediately without waiting for the prior appeal outcome.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is impermissible as the sole registered address for this digital webtoon publishing entity. The Korean National Tax Service requires a physical commercial workplace for corporate, VAT, and local business tax registration, and Korean banks and global app store payment providers such as Apple IAP and Google Play Billing require an actual Korean office, business signage, and an in-country counterpart for invoice and consumer disputes. A virtual address will be rejected at tax registration and bank account onboarding, and may trigger immediate adverse corporate substance review.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist for unannounced inspection by municipal tax or registry authorities: (1) actual street office exists and matches registration; (2) lease or use-right documents are available in Korean; (3) office signage is displayed; (4) employment and payroll records are maintained on site; (5) corporate bank statements and accounting books are kept at the office; (6) a person responsible for tax affairs is present. Quantified risk: moderate-high, approximately 35-50% within the first 12 months for a newly incorporated foreign-owned entity in the digital content sector. Risk is higher if the company has no resident Korean officer or director.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Act of the Republic of Korea (Act No. 1000, as consolidated to January 2025), Part III 'Companies', Chapter 4 'Yuhan Hoesa' (Limited Liability Company), Articles 287-2 through 287-74 inclusive; together with the Commercial Registration Rules and the Registration Fee Schedule of the Supreme Court of Korea.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Commercial Registration Section (Deunggi-gwa) of the Registration Office of the District Court having jurisdiction over the registered office; in Seoul, the Seoul Central District Court Registration Office, under the Supreme Court of Korea.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of Establishment of a Limited Liability Company (Yuhan Hoesa) accompanied by the certified Articles of Incorporation, capital payment certificate, office-use consent, and officer appointment statements; registration is evidenced by the Certificate of Company Registration (deunggi-sahang-jeungmyeongseo).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is imposed on a Yuhan Hoesa. The incorporators may choose the capital amount freely. However, all subscribed capital must be fully deposited into a blocked escrow or provisional subscription account at a licensed Korean bank before the incorporation registration is filed; the bank's capital payment certificate must accompany the registration application. The deposited capital is frozen and may not be released until the court issues the Certificate of Company Registration. For a digital webtoon publishing and syndication company, KRW 10,000,000 (approximately USD 7,500) is recommended to establish bankability and satisfy Apple and Google settlement counterparty requirements.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLUTION OF THE FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF YUHAN HOESA

PRO-FORMA BOARD RESOLUTION NO. 2025-01

WHEREAS, Yuhan Hoesa (the Company) has been formed as a limited liability company under Articles 287-2 through 287-74 of the Korean Commercial Act to engage in digital webtoon publishing, multilingual chapter unlocking, and content syndication; WHEREAS, the initial members have subscribed for capital contribution units and deposited the initial capital into a blocked escrow account at a licensed Korean bank; WHEREAS, the Articles of Incorporation authorize the directors and executive officers to adopt governance measures before the commencement of business; NOW, THEREFORE, IT IS HEREBY RESOLVED THAT:

1. Capital Subscription and Share Capital. The subscription of capital contribution units totaling KRW 10,000,000, as set out in the Articles of Incorporation and in the capital payment certificate issued by [Bank], is ratified in all respects. The Board confirms that each subscriber has validly paid the fully stated amount, that no contribution has been refunded, and that the escrowed funds will continue to be held until the court registration is complete. The Board authorizes the release of escrowed funds after the issuance of the Certificate of Company Registration and the opening of the corporate operating account.

2. Banking Authorization. The Board approves the opening and operation of corporate checking, savings, and dedicated settlement accounts for Apple IAP and Google Play Billing proceeds at [Bank]. The Chief Executive Officer and the Chief Financial Officer, acting together, are authorized to open and close accounts, execute banking mandates, sign payment instructions, manage online banking tokens, and negotiate banking agreements. All operational cash shall be segregated from capital funds and reconciled monthly.

3. Registered Office Adoption. The registered office of the Company is fixed at [full address, building, floor, postal code], Republic of Korea. The Chief Executive Officer is directed to file any required office location notice with the registration court and to maintain a physical office or authorized registered-agent office on the same premises. Any relocation within the first six months shall be immediately registered.

4. Statutory Officer Appointments. The following persons are appointed: [Name] as Representative Executive Officer and Chief Executive Officer; [Name] as Chief Financial Officer; [Name] as Director of Content and Licensing; and [Name] as Compliance Officer and Corporate Secretary. Each officer shall exercise the powers and duties required by the Korean Commercial Act, the Articles of Incorporation, and this Resolution.

5. Implementation and Delegation. The Chief Executive Officer and the Corporate Secretary are jointly directed to complete the business registration with the National Tax Service, open the settlement accounts, and execute platform agreements with Apple and Google for webtoon syndication. The Compliance Officer shall maintain the statutory books, member ledger, accounting records under K-IFRS, and a privacy program compliant with the Personal Information Protection Act. The Board ratifies all lawful acts taken by the incorporators before this Resolution, and any officer may certify a copy of this Resolution for submission to third parties.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Notarization of the Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Supreme Court Internet Registration Service (IRO) and the notary public office in the jurisdiction of the registered office under the Ministry of Justice
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a company name search in the Supreme Court's Internet Registration Office portal. Reserve the Korean legal name of the Yuhan Hoesa and verify that the name is not identical or confusingly similar to a registered trade name. Prepare the Articles of Incorporation in Korean, stating the corporate purpose of digital webtoon publishing, multilingual chapter unlocking and content syndication, the registered office, the amount of issued capital contribution units, and the method of contribution. Each incorporator must sign or seal the Articles, and the document must be notarized by a Korean notary public. The notary will check legal capacity, subscription accuracy, and statutory content requirements. No business may be undertaken before the court registration is completed.
required_dossiers: Passport or alien registration card of each incorporator
Power of attorney for professional formation agent, if applicable
Inspection confirmation of the registered office lease or ownership certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registration court or notary rejects the name or Articles, correct the objection in the court's supplement notice and refile. If the name is refused because of a prior identical trade name, submit a different secondary name and start a new name search. A rejection does not affect the deposit if the deposit has not been withdrawn.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Contribution Deposit and Blocked Account Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial bank in the Republic of Korea conducting corporate and foreign exchange banking under the Financial Services Commission and the Bank of Korea
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary blocked deposit account in the name of the incorporators or the company-under-formation at a licensed Korean bank. Transfer the full stated capital into the account and instruct the bank to issue a capital payment certificate (napim-jeung-myeong). The bank will conduct AML, source-of-funds and sanctions screening under the Financial Transactions Reports Act and the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act. The blocked account may not be withdrawn from before the court registration. After the court issues the corporate registration certificate, the bank releases the funds to the company's operating account only upon presentation of the registration certificate and a copy of this board resolution. For foreign founders, execute a declaration of non-resident ownership and a foreign investment report if the total investment exceeds KRW 50 million.
required_dossiers: Foreign investment report or declaration, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced due diligence, provide audited bank statements, a business-plan justification, and an ownership chart. If the bank still suspends the account, close the preliminary account and open a new blocked account with another licensed bank without withdrawing the contribution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Registration with the District Court Registration Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registration Section, Registration Office of the District Court having jurisdiction over the registered office, or the Internet Registration Office (IRO) portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the application for registration of establishment of the Yuhan Hoesa with the court, attaching the notarized Articles, capital payment certificate, office lease, and consent of the owner. The court reviews the legality of the corporate purpose, which is lawful digital webtoon publishing, the identity of the incorporators, the statutory contents of the Articles, and the appointment of the CEO and other officers. The applicant must confirm that the registered office is located within the court's jurisdiction. After examination, the registration officer enters the company into the Commercial Registration Register, assigns the company registration number, and issues a Certificate of Company Registration. The issuance date is the statutory incorporation date.
required_dossiers: Application for registration of company establishment
Consent to use the registered office from the lessor
Certificate of personal seal impression or notarized signature of each officer
Certificate of subscription of capital contribution units
Report on foreign investment, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the court issues a suspension or supplement order, respond with the requested corrections within 14 days. If the court rejects the application, file an appeal to the district court within 14 days under the Commercial Registration Rules, supported by the deficient documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business Registration and Mandatory Tax Filings with the National Tax Service
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: District tax office of the National Tax Service having jurisdiction over the registered office, accessible through HomeTax (hometax.go.kr)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days after the court registration, file an application for corporation business registration using the corporate registration certificate. The company must register for value-added tax as a general or simplified taxpayer based on expected revenues, obtain an electronic tax invoice user certificate, and apply for a corporate tax identification number. The National Tax Service will verify the office address and representative identity. After approval, the NTS issues the business registration certificate, which is required for opening bank accounts, signing Apple and Google merchant agreements, and issuing VAT invoices. The company should also elect its fiscal year for corporate tax purposes and arrange for K-IFRS bookkeeping from the incorporation date.
required_dossiers: Office lease agreement or fixed-date lease certificate
ID card of the representative executive officer
Bank account certificate for the company
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the NTS sends a business-site verification letter or a data-mismatch notice, submit the lease agreement and utility bill evidence. If the tax office does not issue the registration certificate within seven days, file a complaint through HomeTax, but the company may not issue VAT invoices until the certificate is issued.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Operating Bank Accounts, Social Insurance Registration and Corporate Governance Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Korean commercial bank, the Social Insurance Information Service for the four major social insurance schemes, and the local municipal district office (Gu-cheong) for office occupancy matters
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After business registration, open the corporate operating account and Apple and Google settlement accounts at the selected bank. The bank will examine the board resolution, beneficial ownership declaration and final corporate documents. Register the representative and employees, or the sole executive officer, with the National Pension Service, National Health Insurance Service, Korea Employment Information Service and Korea Workers' Compensation and Welfare Service through the integrated social insurance portal; this is required within 14 days of hire. Prepare the corporate minute book, member ledger, and statutory register of officers. If a foreign investment report was required, file it with the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy or the authorized foreign exchange bank.
required_dossiers: Beneficial ownership declaration for each member
Insurance enrollment applications for officers and employees
Foreign investment declaration form, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank imposes manual review of foreign beneficial owners, supplement with a notarized foreign criminal-record equivalent or a certificate of corporate good-standing. If social insurance portal enrollment fails because of date mismatches, correct the date of hire and refile through the integrated portal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable - the enterprise is a pure digital webtoon publisher and does not operate ISIC 1xxx, 2xxx, 3xxx, 4xxx or 52xx physical manufacturing, chemical, assembly or warehousing facilities. Should the company later lease a physical production studio, the local municipal district office (Gu-cheong) building licensing division would become competent for occupancy authorization.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable - no manufacturing or industrial operating permit arises from ISIC 9000 digital webtoon syndication activity. A standard business registration certificate from the National Tax Service is the only operating authorization required for the digital commercial model.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not Applicable - the Ministry of Environment EIA jurisdiction would exist only for physical projects under the Environmental Impact Assessment Act; no such project is present in this scope.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not Applicable / Exempt - no wastewater, air emissions, or hazardous waste streams are generated; no full EIA report or EIA registration (sahoe) is required for digital webtoon publication and syndication.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable - zero industrial wastewater, zero volatile organic compound process emissions, and zero hazardous waste generation. The only by-product is ordinary domestic office waste, which is subject to municipal collection under the Waste Management Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable for an industrial Civil Defense fire permit because no manufacturing or warehousing operations exist. For the leased commercial office, the building owner must maintain a valid building fire safety certificate under the Fire Prevention and Safety in Buildings Act, and the company must comply with standard office workplace safety obligations under the Occupational Safety and Health Act, including evacuation signage and first aid provision. No Korea Occupational Safety and Health Agency factory approval is required for ISIC 9000 digital services.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: National Tax Service (NTS) of the Republic of Korea, with the statutory electronic portal being HomeTax (https://www.hometax.go.kr), supported by the NTS English website (https://www.nts.go.kr) and, for export clearance, the Korea Customs Service UNI-PASS portal (https://unipass.customs.go.kr).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a non-resident investor forming a Yuhan Hoesa (Korean limited liability company), the company must first complete Korean commercial registration at the district court-level registration office; the court issues the unique Korean corporate registration number. The statutory tax registration with the National Tax Service occurs separately: within 20 days of commencement of a domestic taxable business the representative director (or a duly appointed tax representative for foreign-owned companies) must file the standard Business Registration Application to the NTS district tax office with territorial jurisdiction over the registered office. Supporting documents include the certificate of incorporation, commercial registration certificate, articles of incorporation, foreign investor passport/director ID, power of attorney, and local office lease evidence. The NTS validates the application and issues the 10-digit Business Registration Number, which serves as the company's TIN and VAT registration number for all electronic tax invoices, VAT returns, withholding tax administration and corporate tax filings. The same procedure applies for a foreign corporation registering a Korean-sourced taxable business through a permanent establishment; in that case the foreign head office must appoint an NTS-recognized tax representative and attach its home-country tax residence certificate. After registration, the company should procure a recognized joint digital security certificate for HomeTax electronic filing and e-tax invoice transmission. No separate VAT ID is required; the Business Registration Number is the single tax identity.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. South Korea does not operate a check-the-box or hybrid-entity elective classification regime for a Yuhan Hoesa; a Korean limited liability company is statutorily a domestic corporation subject to entity-level corporate taxation. Hybrid mismatch outcomes are corrected under the law's OECD BEPS Action 2-aligned provisions, not by taxpayer election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax under the Republic of Korea Value-Added Tax Act - a credit-invoice, quarterly-return VAT with a uniform single-stage headline rate and electronic tax invoice obligation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: None in local currency terms: a Korean Yuhan Hoesa must register for VAT from the first taxable supply; there is no economic turnover threshold excusing a corporation from registration. For individual sole proprietors only, a simplified taxable-person computation is available under the VAT Act for small turnover, but that concession is not available to a Yuhan Hoesa, which remains under the standard credit-invoice regime regardless of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All B2B supplies and export transactions must be documented with an electronic tax invoice issued through the NTS HomeTax e-Tax Invoice system or a certified electronic tax invoice service provider. The electronic tax invoice must be transmitted to the NTS at or immediately after issue, and no later than the next day after issuance, in the mandated electronic data set; the system validates VAT numbers, supply value, tax amount and transaction parties, and retains an electronic audit trail. Korea does not issue a per-transaction CFDI-style fiscal stamp or require government API pre-clearance of every invoice, but the HomeTax platform provides machine-readable e-filing APIs and the mandatory electronic tax invoice dataset must contain all statutory fields. Failure to transmit, late transmission, or issuance of false electronic tax invoices makes input VAT non-deductible and subjects the issuer to additional taxes under the VAT Act.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rated export treatment is available under Article 21 of the Value-Added Tax Act for (i) goods that are actually exported from Korea through customs, and (ii) services supplied to non-residents, including digital webtoon content, where the place of supply is outside Korea and the services are not consumed or enjoyed in Korea. The Yuhan Hoesa's multilingual webtoon chapter unlocking transactions sold through Apple IAP and Google Play Billing to non-Korean end-customers qualify for 0% VAT if the company retains platform-level transaction evidence proving that the purchaser's App Store or Play Store country of account and the consumer location are outside the Republic of Korea, the sale is concluded with the overseas store entity or the ultimate non-resident consumer, and the proceeds are received in foreign exchange by Korea from an authorized settlement channel rather than merely invoiced to a domestic entity.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Korea Customs Service UNI-PASS electronic export declaration (the statutory customs export clearance record for physical merchandise; functionally equivalent to a Bill of Entry, and mandatory for any ancillary physical goods or collectible items shipped from Korea; for pure digital webtoon supply with no physical goods this declaration is replaced by a digital service export ledger).
Bill of Lading (or air waybill) evidencing actual physical transportation out of Korea; not applicable to consumable digital chapter unlocks but mandatory for tangible comic-book merchandise.

Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) or, for Korea, a bank-issued Foreign Exchange Transaction Receipt evidencing that the export value was repatriated into a Korean foreign-exchange bank account in convertible currency within the statutory export-proceeds deadline.
Apple App Store Connect and Google Play Console settlement reports showing the transaction, country of delivery, currency and net proceeds remitted by the offshore platform entity.

Customer-territory evidence: App Store or Google Play account country, IP-address geolocation audit logs, and the digital license metadata substantiating that each chapter unlock was delivered outside Korea.
Export sales contract, Webtoon content licensing or end-user terms, zero-rated electronic tax invoice marked as export, and the foreign-currency purchase order or payment file.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The NTS and Korea Customs Service will deny zero-rating if the supporting customs declaration, shipping documents, platform settlement reports, FIRC-equivalent bank receipt, or end-user location evidence are false, missing, or internally inconsistent. A denied export zero-rating is clawed back retrospectively by computing 10% VAT on the full uncollected export consideration, adding the standard additional tax for understated VAT and failure to issue valid tax receipts, and applying daily or monthly delinquency charges from the original filing deadline. If the export proceeds are not physically repatriated in the required 180-day foreign-exchange window, the NTS treats the supply as having enjoyed unjustified zero-rating and foreign-exchange penalties may also apply. Fraudulent falsification of export documents or deliberate use of shell app-store transactions to fabricate an export qualifies for criminal liability under the Punishment of Tax Evaders Act, including fines and imprisonment, together with the extended reassessment period for fraudulent non-disclosure.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bank of Korea (BOK) under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act, with the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MOEF) as foreign exchange policy regulator and the Korea Financial Intelligence Unit (KOFIU) as AML supervisor
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: South Korea operates a liberalized but regulated foreign exchange system under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act, with Bank of Korea and Ministry of Economy and Finance as the primary regulators. The won is broadly convertible for current account activities such as trade settlements, royalties, and service fees, although every transaction above defined thresholds must be processed through a designated foreign exchange bank and reported for statistical and supervision purposes. Capital account operations, including foreign equity injections, loans, and repatriation of invested capital, have moved toward free notification in principle, but remain subject to declaration or approval depending on the sector and counterparty jurisdiction. There are no daily conversion ceilings for corporates, yet all receipts and payments must be justified by underlying commercial documentation. Profit remittance in the form of shareholder dividends is permitted after payment of corporate income tax and dividend withholding tax, followed by submission of audited financial statements, tax payment certificates, and the relevant foreign exchange business form to the bank. In practice, the bank performs an enhanced review to prevent disguised capital flight. The Republic of Korea maintains real-time transaction monitoring through the Korea Financial Intelligence Unit.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exporters must collect export proceeds in foreign currency within six months from the date of export declaration or the date of loading, unless a justifiable extension is granted by the designated foreign exchange bank or Bank of Korea. There is no mandatory conversion ratio; the exporter may hold foreign currency in domestic foreign-currency accounts or convert to KRW at prevailing market rates. Uncollected export proceeds must be reported and may incur administrative penalties if the exporter fails to obtain legitimate credit guarantee or delay justification.

Basic Operational Currency Account for Trade and Royalty Disbursements
Integrated FX Account and Capital Escrow Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore fintech EMIs such as Revolut Business, Wise, and Payoneer have low viability as primary corporate banking suppliers in South Korea. Under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act, a foreign exchange business license from the Ministry of Economy and Finance is required to debit and credit KRW corporate accounts or to execute domestic clearing. Unlicensed EMIs cannot provide Korean settlement accounts, cannot receive app-store KRW payouts from Apple and Google, and may not sign up as the entity's designated foreign exchange bank. They could be used only for auxiliary USD/EUR collections outside Korea, but local payroll, VAT payments, and capital verifications still require a licensed domestic bank. The risk exists that EMIs are legally barred from servicing Korean domestic entities for local-currency treasury operations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a domestic Yuhan Hoesa, statutory directors and authorized signatories are required to physically appear in-branch at the initial account-opening interview as a rule under the Real Name Financial Transactions Act and the suspicious transaction reporting regime. Remote consular proxy opening is generally not permitted for domestic Korean corporations; a notarized power of attorney may allow a local financial officer to complete onboarding only after the director has appeared once or the bank confirms identity through a recognized overseas branch if the director is a non-resident. Video-based KYC is possible for initial screening but must be supplemented by hard-copy corporate documents, corporate seal certificates, and in-person at bank discretion.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque ultimate beneficial ownership chain in a single-member LLC
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified corporate registry extracts addressed to the bank, articles of incorporation, full shareholder register, KYC form naming every 25% plus owner, passport copies of all natural-person UBOs, director personal identity documents, and a notarized UBO declaration compliant with the Korean Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Undocumented source of paid-in capital for an LLC with no minimum capital
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank statements covering the preceding six months for all participating shareholders, tax returns, salary or bonus contracts, audited parent financial statements, source-of-funds declaration, and a foreign exchange declaration filed with the designated bank for any routed cross-border capital injection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume digital micropayment flows from Apple IAP and Google Play with refund volume and jurisdictional risk
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified app store agreements with Apple and Google, published content licenses and IP chain-of-title documents, monthly royalty and settlement reconciliation statements, refund policy documents, customer dispute logs, chargeback reporting, and the entity's AML transaction monitoring plan for recurring platform payouts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, PEP, or adverse-media flags on corporate directors
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Negative media search reports from LSEG World-Check or equivalent, certificates of no criminal record from Korea and the director's country of residence, affidavits of source of wealth, passport and tax residency proof, and a board resolution approving the director for the specific banking relationship.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital is remitted via SWIFT MT103 through the designated foreign exchange bank with the corporate registration number and purpose code in the narrative field. For foreign direct investment, the entity must submit a notifiable foreign exchange declaration to the Bank of Korea via the relevant bank, maintain a receipt of the KRW conversion, and complete paid-in capital verification through a certified public accountant for statutory capital. All inflows must pass through a domestic bank account and cannot be held offshore until after capital verification.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Digital webtoon syndication royalties and app store content licensing payouts should use SWIFT MT103 remittance messages with purpose codes for service fees or intellectual property royalties, tax withholding certificates attached. Commercial letters of credit are not the standard rail for digital content; documentary collections are reserved for physical merchandise collateral transactions. Domestic disbursements to Korean creators and tax withholding agencies clear through the Korea Financial Telecommunications and Clearing network, while cross-border wire exits require the underlying platform agreement and payment schedule as AML evidence.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable KRW/USD forward contracts entered through a licensed Seoul Foreign Exchange Market bank with documentary underlying exposure
Offshore or onshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) subject to Bank of Korea position limits and real-demand verification
Cross-currency interest rate swaps or currency swaps restricted to long-term foreign currency debt and licensed by the bank for genuine economic hedge
FX options, specifically put and call options purchased for hedging app store royalty receipts and forecasted North American licensing income

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return and Tax Base Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year Yuhan Hoesa, by March 31 of the following year. A one-month extension is available upon application where all prior returns have been duly filed.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure-to-file additional tax of 20% of the assessed corporate income tax; negligent underreporting additional tax of 10% of the omitted tax amount; fraudulent underreporting additional tax of 40%; plus statutory late-payment interest from the original due date until full payment. Persistent tax delinquency triggers compulsory seizure of bank accounts and receivables by the NTS. No automatic annual strike-off exists, but a company that remains completely idle for three consecutive years may be administratively deregistered by court order.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Local Corporate Income Tax Return (Local Income Tax component of corporate tax)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Competent local government (metropolitan city, city, or county) through co-filing with the NTS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same statutory due date as the national corporate income tax return: March 31 after calendar year-end, with the same one-month extension where the national return is extended.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Additional tax on non-filing or underreporting under the Framework Act on Local Taxes, generally mirroring the national schedule: 20% for non-filing, 10% for negligent underreporting, and 40% for intentional fraudulent underreporting. Local late-payment interest accrues for each day of delay, and unpaid local corporate income tax is collected through the compulsory local tax collection procedure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Semi-Annual Value-Added Tax Preliminary and Final Returns
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: District Tax Office / National Tax Service via HomeTax
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year books: preliminary return for January-March due April 25; first-half final return for January-June due July 25; preliminary return for July-September due October 25; and second-half final return for July-December due January 25 of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: VAT non-filing triggers a 20% failure-to-file additional tax on the net VAT due, plus late-payment interest at the statutory daily rate until payment is completed. Habitual non-filing may result in cancellation of the business registration by the tax office, which terminates the company's authority to issue tax invoices and exposes the company to immediate tax assessment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Wage and Business Income Withholding Statements and Employer Year-End Tax Settlement Filings
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Tax Service via HomeTax and the relevant local tax office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly payroll withholding tax payments are due by the 10th of the following month; annual wage statements, retirement income statements, and business income statements must be furnished to employees and the NTS by the statutory filing date at the beginning of the following year, generally February or March.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Underpaid or unpaid withholding tax is subject to additional tax of up to 20% of the deficiency, plus late-payment interest; failure to deliver required statements to payees or the NTS triggers per-document penalties. Delinquent withholding tax is a preferential claim and may lead to asset seizure if not cured.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Investment Status Report and Change Report (if the LLC is registered as a foreign-invested company)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy (MOTIE) through the Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency (KOTRA) or a designated foreign exchange bank
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual foreign investment status report for the prior calendar year due by March 31 of each year; any share transfer, capital increase or decrease, change of foreign investor, or change in foreign investment ratio must be reported within 30 days after the triggering event.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or late filing of foreign investment reports may result in administrative fines under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act, and may suspend eligibility for foreign-investment protection benefits and repatriation privileges. It does not by itself strike off the LLC from the commercial register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: External Audit Report and Annual Financial Statements Disclosure (only when statutory audit threshold is triggered)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) through the designated electronic disclosure system, and the external auditor
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Financial statements must be prepared within three months after fiscal year-end, approved by the members' meeting no later than the statutory annual meeting window, and, when audited, the audit report must be reported to the FSS within the statutory period after approval.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to obtain a required external audit exposes the company and its directors to administrative fines under the Act on External Audit of Stock Companies; refusal to file audited financial statements may be treated as a deficiency in corporate tax return documentation and can trigger separate additional tax penalties and regulatory sanctions.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under the Act on External Audit of Stock Companies, as applied to a Yuhan Hoesa LLC, mandatory independent CPA audit is triggered where the company at the end of the immediately preceding fiscal year has total assets of at least KRW 12 billion (approximately USD 8.9 million). For ordinary unlisted private LLCs, turnover and headcount are not standalone audit triggers; however, where the company qualifies as a public-interest entity or financial company, the audit mandate also applies if at least two of the following three thresholds are exceeded: (i) total assets of KRW 12 billion; (ii) annual revenue of KRW 100 billion; (iii) average headcount of 300 or more employees. Any statutory audit must be performed by a certified public accountant registered with the Financial Supervisory Service. The revenue and headcount tests are supplemental to, and not substitutes for, the statutory asset test; otherwise the LLC is exempt from mandatory external audit unless the articles of incorporation or financing covenants require one.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Korean International Financial Reporting Standards (K-IFRS), which are the IFRS standards as adopted by Korea, are required for publicly listed and public-interest companies. A non-listed Yuhan Hoesa may apply the Korean Generally Accepted Accounting Principles for non-public entities (K-GAAP / Business Accounting Standards for SMEs) if it is below mandatory audit thresholds, but may voluntarily elect K-IFRS. Financial statements must be prepared in Korean won and present a true and fair view of the financial position and performance in accordance with the Commercial Act and the Act on External Audit of Stock Companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: South Korea does not impose a standalone annual UBO return on an ordinary Yuhan Hoesa LLC. Instead, the company must maintain an accurate member register and director register at its registered office. If the LLC is a foreign-invested company under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act, the foreign shareholder must submit an annual Foreign Investment Status Report to MOTIE through KOTRA or a designated foreign exchange bank no later than March 31 for the prior calendar year. Any transfer of shares or change in the identity, nationality, or percentage of the foreign beneficial owner must be reported within 30 days after the closing of the transfer. Domestic member changes remain subject to company-level register maintenance but do not require a separate annual government confirmation; however, any change of registered office, directors, or capital must be registered with the competent Korean Commercial Registration Court.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Auditors (if statutory auditor is appointed)
Minute Book and Members' Resolution Records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350 - USD 1,200 per year for registered office or registered agent and corporate secretarial support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 8,000 - USD 25,000 per year for a certified CPA audit if the KRW 12 billion asset threshold is triggered; otherwise USD 0

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% for the top marginal bracket (progressive rates 10%, 20%, 22%, 25%); plus 2.5% local income tax surcharge (10% of corporate tax) on PAX? -- aggregated 27.5% total statutory gross burden
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Foreign-invested high-tech entities in Free Economic Zones are eligible for 100% corporate income tax exemption for the first 3 to 5 years and 50% for the following 2 years; R&D super-deduction up to 20-50% of qualifying R&D expenditure under the Restriction of Special Taxation Act; technology acquisition deductions; overseas income imputation credits under the International Tax Coordination Act; no specific patent box regime, but technology transfer capital gains may be deferred and reinvested tax-free

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: National Tax Service Corporate Tax Return (Form 1) - 법인세 과세표준 및 세액신고서, including the Supplementary Schedule for Foreign Corporation's Domestic Branch Income; mandatory e-filing via HomeTax (hometax.go.kr)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing is due within 3 months from the end of the fiscal year (Article 60 of the Corporate Tax Act; Article 12 of the International Tax Coordination Act for foreign corporations); for a December 31 FYE, the statutory deadline is March 31 of the next calendar year; one-month extension is available if fiscal statements are audited under the External Audit Act.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Business Revenue / Gross Sales (Webtoon Digital Content, Coin Top-ups, Chapter Unlocks, Syndication Royalties)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate gross revenues from digital comic chapters, in-app purchase coins, platform subscriptions, advertisement, IP licensing and export syndication fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a foreign corporation with a Korean permanent establishment (PE), report only domestic-source revenues attributable to that PE. For a Korean-resident Yuhan Hoesa, report worldwide revenue. Apple IAP and Google Play Billing collections must be reported at gross level; platform fees are not netted against revenue. Any intercompany subscription fees charged by an overseas group entity require an arm's-length pricing justification and the TP documentation threshold check.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Cost of Sales (Creative Production Costs, Artist Royalties, Cloud Hosting, Platform Commission Costs)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs of producing webtoon chapters, creator royalties, translator fees, server hosting, and channel store commission costs recognized as an expense for tax accounting.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Costs paid to foreign affiliates must meet the arm's length principle under Article 5 of the International Tax Coordination Act; contemporaneous Local File documentation is required if the annual aggregate foreign related-party transaction amount exceeds KRW 5 billion. For a foreign corporation's PE, only expenses directly attributable to the Korean business and substantiated with invoices are deductible; apportioned head-office overhead requires a tax office approval and cannot reduce income below zero in a manner inconsistent with treaty nondiscrimination.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Automatic computation of Box 1 minus Box 2.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No entry input is required; however, the gross margin in webtoon syndication must be checked against benchmark data, especially if the content is licensed to an overseas affiliate. A chronic low-margin position may trigger an income adjustment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 - Selling, General and Administrative Expenses (Marketing, Depreciation, Employee Compensation, Insurance, Cloud Services)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenses, including director remuneration, marketing, depreciation of developed-IP and servers, software amortization and corporate insurance.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident corporation, only expenses incurred for the PE's business inside Korea are deductible. Management fees paid to a foreign parent are disallowed unless the parent can prove concrete rendering of services (ITCA Article 95) and the fees are at arm's length. The webtoon entity must not book a residual profit to the parent through excessive SG&A fees.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 - Add-back and Tax Adjustment Items (Non-deductible Expenses, Entertainment Limits, Reserves, Tax Penalties)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enforceable statutory additions for items such as corporate entertainment above the legal cap, fines, tax penalties, non-deductible reserves, and undisclosed income amounts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter all non-deductible fines and penalties; for a year with gross revenue exceeding KRW 10 billion, only 50% of entertainment expenses exceeding the statutory cap is deductible. If a transaction is conducted with a tax haven affiliate without economic substance, the adjustment is made under ITCA Article 80, disallowing the related expense or including undeclared foreign undistributed income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final income subject to corporate income tax after the application of adjustments and permitted income deductions (loss carryforwards et al.).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Korean-sourced net income of a non-resident with a PE is limited to domestic-source items enumerated under ITCA Article 93. Treaty income attribution rules apply, and taxpayers must attach a PE income attribution schedule. Loss carryforward of 15 years is recognized only if the prior year return was filed timely and the fiscal year has lasted at least 6 months.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 - Tax Reduction and Credits (Foreign Tax Credit, R&D Tax Credit, Investment Tax Credit)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Subtract tax credits from the calculated gross tax, including foreign tax credit under ITCA Article 81 and credits under Article 10 of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A resident Yuhan Hoesa can claim a foreign tax credit for actual taxes paid to a foreign country on foreign-source income; the credit amount is capped at the Korean tax attributable to that foreign income. For non-residents, no credit is granted against the WHT of the foreign shareholder. R&D credits for digital content development are enumerated; if unused, the credit carryforward is 10 years.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 - Final Corporate Income Tax Payable (including Branch Profits Tax and Local Income Tax Charge)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross corporate tax less credits equals the final tax payable; for a foreign PE, add the branch remittance tax payable upon actual repatriation of after-tax branch profits; aggregate local income tax is declared in a supporting schedule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a domestic subsidiary, the branch tax does not apply. The 10% local income tax surcharge is a declared amount attached to the main form. For any distribution to foreign shareholders, 22% dividend withholding tax must be accrued and paid. If the Yuhan Hoesa makes an outbound dividend while loss carryforward is unused, the dividend WHT is still payable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 9 (supporting schedule) - Withholding Declaration for Outbound Distributions, Interest and Royalties to Non-Residents
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of all payments to foreign shareholders, foreign lenders and foreign licensors subject to withholding under Article 67-2 and Article 67-3 of the Corporate Tax Act, with a treaty relief attachment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A separate withholding return must be lodged before the 10th day of the month following payment to a non-resident. Statutory rates are 20% plus 2% local surcharge = 22% for dividends, interest and royalties. To claim the relevant bilateral DTA rate, the payor or recipient must file a treaty-application schedule, attach the Tax Residency Certificate and Beneficial Ownership Statement, and prove economic substance in the foreign jurisdiction.

stage_6.failure_penalties: Failure to file the corporate tax return by the statutory deadline triggers a penalty of 20% of the unpaid tax if never filed, or 10% if filed late; a non-payment surcharge of 0.03% per day also accrues, subject to a cap of 22% of the unpaid tax. An unfaithful return with understated income results in a 20% penalty; a fraudulent or intentionally false return results in a 100% penalty of the evaded tax and criminal prosecution under Article 3 of the Punishment of Tax Evaders Act (imprisonment of up to 5 years, or up to 7 years where evasion exceeds KRW 300 million). Failure to withhold and remit WHT on outbound dividends or royalties is personally assessable on the representative director and carries an additional 100% penalty and possible criminal sanction.
